name: Advanced Survivor Path [Psionic]
body:
You are capable of withstanding a variety of situations.

Prerequisites: Con 13, Mind Over Body, Toughness, Survivor path class feature, manifester level 10th, base attack bonus +6

Benefit: When using the Survivor trance, you gain resistance to your active energy type. The resistance is equal to 5 for every four psychic warrior levels you have. In addition, when using the Survivor maneuver, the bonus to Will saves can instead apply to Fortitude saves.
